stem: Bianca wants a better concluding sentence for her paper. Which sentence should replace sentence 35?

options.label: A
options.text: Learning is something that we should never stop doing as long as we live.

options.label: B
options.text: Even some of the smallest creatures on the planet can do amazing things.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a discovery that will not be forgotten by those who read about it.

options.label: D
options.text: Animals should be known for their unique qualities, and they must be saved.
